body: Thank you, @FlamingFireCoding. Triage: `enhancement`, `P8` (a new operation that needs design first), `effort:max` (new toolpath algorithm, under our safety floor), `area:multiaxis`, `needs-research`. It is close to #2772 (4-axis rotary carving of any model on a stated axis) and #2774 (rotary heights as radii): research will decide whether Rotary Flow is its own operation or a mode of that work. Clean-room: we spec it from published 4-axis/flow-line machining literature only, not from another CAM's operation. Your rotor files on #2772 will be the test part.

## Research findings

### 1. Own operation vs. mode of #2772
`Rotary Flow` should be its own operation kind (`OpType::RotaryFlow`) in `Section::MultiAxis`, not a mode of `RotaryParallel` (#2772). It should share the stated rotary axis resolver from #2772 and the radial heights model from #2774.

Evidence:
- `RotaryParallel` reads a whole solid (`SrcRef::Entity` or `SrcRef::Stock`) and generates straight axial passes with `finishing3d::swarf` (`crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary.rs`, `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`). `selection_drives_region` excludes `RotaryParallel` from feature picks (`crates/app/src/operation/material_region.rs`).
- `Rotary Flow` needs picked edge chains (`SrcRef::Selection` of `FeatureSel::Chain`), like `MultiAxisContour` (`crates/app/src/operation/selection.rs`, `crates/app/src/mcp/pick.rs`). It also needs an optional `stepover` between guide chains.
- CamCraft separates kinds that change geometry input or direction law (`Parallel5D`, `Flow5D`, `MultiAxisContour` in `crates/app/src/operation/types/sel.rs` and `crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`).

### 2. Rotation axis source (axis fit vs. #2772)
`axis::fit` alone fails on helical parts, so `Rotary Flow` depends on #2772 for a stated or machine-derived rotary axis.

Evidence:
- `axis::fit` checks normal-line concurrency (`crates/motion/src/multiaxis/axis.rs`, `axis_consensus.rs`). It rejects a mesh when fewer than 90% (`OK_SHARE`) or 75% (`CONSENSUS_SHARE`) of non-pole facets meet one line within `0.03 * rho` (`REL_TOL`).
- Helical lobes, augers, screws, and propellers have skew normals that miss the rotation axis. Those skew normals caused the refusal on `Rotor.camproj` in #2772.
- Four call sites currently run `axis::fit` directly: `rotary::rotary_parallel` (`crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary.rs`), `rotary_letter_gate` (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`), `rotary_into` (`crates/app/src/operation/rotary_law.rs`, which fails closed as `Warning::Gouge`), and `fixture::rotary_axis_of` (`crates/app/src/fixture.rs`, required by `crates/app/src/stock_sim_rotary.rs`). All four sites must accept the shared axis from #2772.

### 3. Planning frame and flow-line algorithm
Plan in cylindrical unwrapped coordinates `(theta, v, rho)` (as in `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary_sheet.rs` and `wrap_exit.rs`), not in `rotary_parallel`'s laid-down `(X, Y, Z)` frame.

Evidence:
- `rotary_parallel` plans in a laid-down `TiltedFrame` with `finishing3d::swarf` and `support.rs` (`m.z >= SPLIT_MZ`, vertical `-Z` drops). That projection covers only one hemisphere (`crates/app/tests/rotary_verify.rs`) and folds over itself on multi-turn helices.
- `rotary_parallel` refuses vertical Z-aligned axes (`flat < LEAN_MIN * LEAN_MIN` in `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary.rs`). However, a mill-turn spindle C axis turns about world Z (`stamp_c_about` in `crates/app/src/operation/rotary_gate.rs`, `crates/app/tests/rotary_letter.rs`).
- Cylindrical `(theta, v, rho)` space is axis-neutral (`crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary_offset.rs`). It unwraps multi-turn helical chains continuously with `unwrap_near` (`crates/cl/src/cl/rotary.rs`).
- Published 4-axis cylindrical flow-line and iso-parametric CAM literature gives the clean-room method:
  1. Unwrap two guide curves into `(theta, v)` space and align their `2 * pi` branch.
  2. Interpolate intermediate `(theta, v)` flow curves using perpendicular arc-length `stepover` (or `scallop_stepover` from `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/params.rs`).
  3. Find the outermost gouge-free radial ball center `rho_ball(theta, v)` where `min_tri dist(center, tri) >= r` via closed-form Voronoi point-triangle distance (`closest_pt_tri` in `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/support.rs`).
  4. That sphere-drop avoids gouging steep helical flanks where surface normals tilt off the radial.

### 4. Heights and radial linking
Use radial cylinders (#2774) for `clearance` and `retract` links, and do not clip 360-degree chains by world Z bounds.

Evidence:
- `rotary_links::radial_relink` validates `clearance` and `retract` as radii above `rho_part` (`crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary_links.rs`).
- `MultiAxisContour` refuses vertices outside `[bottom_z, top_z]` (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`). That check would reject helical chains on a horizontal A-axis part.
- Until #2774 changes the UI for all rotary operations, `Rotary Flow` should treat `clearance_z` and `retract_z` as radial heights in the rotary frame and use `top_z`/`bottom_z` as axial station limits (or radial limits once #2774 lands).

### 5. Tool pose, lead/lag/max_tilt, and 4-axis vs. spindle C kinematics
Default `lead_deg` and `lag_deg` to `0.0` so cut moves use pure radial poses, and clamp lean through `command_axis` (`crates/motion/src/multiaxis/tilt.rs`).

Evidence:
- On a lone A-axis mill (`only_x_rotary` and `x_rotary_problem` in `crates/app/src/machine/judge.rs`, `aRotary` and `toolAngle` in `assets/posts/tormach.cps`), reachable poses have `axis.x == 0`. Non-zero `lead_deg` along a helical move introduces an X component, which the machine check and post refuse.
- Note on non-RTCP 4-axis posts: `tormach.cps` maps `A0 B180` (the bottom half of a cylinder) to `A180` and unwraps continuous A turns, while `doosan-dnm.cps` (`rtcp !== true`, `tilt`) refuses `B != 0`.
- On a mill-turn C axis (`stamp_c` and `on_station` in `crates/cl/src/cl/rotary.rs`), `STATION_TOL` refuses any lean off the `+X` radial station (`~0.06 deg`).
- `stamp_spindle_c` (`crates/app/src/operation/rotary_gate.rs`) currently enables `unwind_c` only for `RotaryContour` (`radial = false` in `crates/cl/src/cl/rotary_unwind.rs`). Multi-turn helical passes on travel-limited C machines (`assets/machines/millturn.mch`, `-360..360`) need radial-cylinder C unwind (`radial = true`) or a continuous C axis.

### 6. Safety, verification, and stock simulation
`Rotary Flow` maps to `Mode::Rotary`, uses `verify::rotary_hits` (`crates/sim/src/verify/rotary.rs`), `rotary_law::rotary_into`, `workholding_warnings` (`crates/app/src/fixture.rs`), `audit_bar` (`crates/app/src/operation/plunge_solid.rs`), and `Stock::simulate_rotary` (`crates/app/src/stock_sim_rotary.rs`). All verification helpers must receive the shared axis from #2772.

---

## Design proposal (smallest useful first slice first)

### Slice 1: Two-chain cylindrical flow kernel and app wiring (minimal end-to-end slice)
1. **Kernel (`crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary_flow.rs`):**
   - Accept `chains: &[Vec<Point3>]`, `facets: &[Triangle]`, `ax: &Axis` (from #2772), `RotaryFlowParams`, and `AxisControl`.
   - Require a ball-nose tool and at least two picked chains in slice 1 (refuse 0 or 1 chain by name). Verify that chain points lie on the mesh.
   - Unwrap each chain into continuous `(theta, v)` coordinates about `ax` and align each pair `(C_k, C_{k+1})` by nearest `2 * pi` offset.
   - Parameterize the pair by normalized arc length, compute the perpendicular width in developed `(s, v)` coordinates, and choose pass count from `stepover` or `scallop_stepover(r, tolerance)`.
   - Sample each interpolated `(theta, v)` curve adaptively within `ARC_FIT_TOL` / `tolerance`, solve the gouge-free radial ball center `rho_ball(theta, v)` against the mesh (`closest_pt_tri`), link passes on the retract cylinder (`rotary_links` radial retract, index, plunge or `Ramp`), and emit tip positions with `retip` and `command_axis`.
2. **App wiring (`crates/app`):**
   - Add `OpType::RotaryFlow` (`tag 44`, `Section::MultiAxis`, `Mode::Rotary`, `tk::BALL`), `OpParams::RotaryFlow`, and `ParamsDto::RotaryFlow` (`PROJECT_VERSION` bump).
   - Wire `drive_chains_of`, `selection_drives_region`, `rotary_letter_gate`, `stamp_spindle_c` (`unwinds = false` initially, like `RotaryParallel`), `rotary_law::rotary_into`, `fidelity_law::finish_tol_of`, `plunge_solid::audit_bar`, `fixture::rotary_axis_of`, and `posting_section_mode::classify`.
   - Pin with tests on the #2772 rotor fixture for 4-axis A (`tormach-770mx-microarc4.mch`) and spindle C (`millturn.mch` within travel).

### Slice 2: UI panel, original icon, and MCP pick door
- Add an original `op-rotary-flow` icon in `assets/ui/` and register it in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/icons.rs` and `op_icons.rs`.
- Add `OpParams::RotaryFlow` fields in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/rotary_page.rs` (using `rotary_editor`, `rotary_axis_editor`, and chain-pick geometry hints).
- Add `OpParams::RotaryFlow` to `crates/app/src/mcp/pick.rs::kind_door` to require `FeatureSel::Chain` picks; `add_operation`, `edit_operation`, and `list_operation_types` already work from `KindInfo::ALL` and `ParamsDto`.

### Slice 3: Radial C-axis unwind, stock simulation parity, and expanded chain modes
- Prove `unwind_c(..., radial = true)` for radial retract links and enable `Stock::simulate_rotary` (`rotary_kind_lift`) with a heavy-lane `rotary_field_parity.rs` test.
- Extend `rotary_flow` to handle 3+ ordered guide chains and single-chain full-revolution (`C_0` to `C_0 + 2 * pi`) periodic wrapping.

---

## Concrete sub-issues

1. **`motion: add Rotary Flow cylindrical flow-line kernel for picked helical guide chains`**
   - Implements `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary_flow.rs` to unwrap picked guide chains into `(theta, v)` coordinates about a stated `Axis`, step flow lines across pairs, and place gouge-free radial ball centers with radial linking.
   - Done means: `rotary_flow` generates gouge-free, radially posed passes across multi-turn helical bands on a rotor mesh in `crates/motion` tests and refuses invalid or under-constrained chains by name.
   - Proposed priority: `P6`, effort: `effort:max`, area: `area:multiaxis`

2. **`app: wire OpType::RotaryFlow operation, drive chains, radial verify, and spindle C gate`**
   - Adds `OpType::RotaryFlow`, `OpParams::RotaryFlow`, and `ParamsDto::RotaryFlow` and wires chain resolution, shared axis lookup (#2772), radial verification, fixture checks, and spindle C stamping.
   - Done means: `CreateOperation` and `GenerateOperation` produce verified, postable G-code for `Rotary Flow` on 4-axis A/B mills and C-axis mill-turns on the #2772 rotor fixture with zero verify warnings.
   - Proposed priority: `P6`, effort: `effort:high`, area: `area:multiaxis`

3. **`ui/mcp: add Rotary Flow property page, original icon, and edge-chain pick door`**
   - Adds an original `op-rotary-flow` icon, wires `RotaryFlow` fields in `rotary_page.rs`, and enforces `FeatureSel::Chain` picks in `mcp/pick.rs`.
   - Done means: `Rotary Flow` renders in the Multi-axis section with passing UI structural tests, and MCP tools create, edit, pick chains for, and refuse non-chain picks on `Rotary Flow` operations.
   - Proposed priority: `P6`, effort: `effort:medium`, area: `area:multiaxis`

4. **`sim/cl: prove Rotary Flow stock simulation parity and radial C-axis unwind`**
   - Enables `RotaryFlow` in `stock_sim_rotary::rotary_kind_lift` with a parity proof and enables `unwind_c(..., radial = true)` for travel-limited spindle C machines.
   - Done means: `rotary_field_parity.rs` proves `Stock::simulate_rotary` parity for `RotaryFlow`, and multi-pass helical paths unwind cleanly on `millturn.mch` (`-360..360`) at radial retract cylinders.
   - Proposed priority: `P6`, effort: `effort:high`, area: `area:multiaxis`

5. **`motion: support multi-band chain lists and single-chain periodic wrap in Rotary Flow`**
   - Extends `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary_flow.rs` to interpolate across 3+ ordered chains and wrap a single helical chain across one full `2 * pi` turn.
   - Done means: `RotaryFlow` generates full-coverage, gouge-free passes from a single helical edge chain and from 3+ ordered chains on helical screw fixtures, while refusing intersecting chains by name.
   - Proposed priority: `P7`, effort: `effort:high`, area: `area:multiaxis`

Filed the sub-issues for this research:

1. #2824 — `motion: add Rotary Flow cylindrical flow-line kernel for picked helical guide chains` (`P6`, `effort:max`, `area:multiaxis`)
2. #2826 — `app: wire OpType::RotaryFlow operation, drive chains, radial verify, and spindle C gate` (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:multiaxis`)
3. #2827 — `ui/mcp: add Rotary Flow property page, original icon, and edge-chain pick door` (`P6`, `effort:medium`, `area:multiaxis`)
4. #2828 — `sim/cl: prove Rotary Flow stock simulation parity and radial C-axis unwind` (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:multiaxis`)
5. #2829 — `motion: support multi-band chain lists and single-chain periodic wrap in Rotary Flow` (`P7`, `effort:high`, `area:multiaxis`)

The umbrella issue stays open for maintainer review.
